$Comment: Present Thieves after dark while Christmas runs, written as the world-spawn rule
Christmas_Present_Thieves_Night when Christmas starts and stilled (every moon phase at zero) when it
ends. They come in ones and twos onto soil in the first zone's woods, forests and plains from seven
at night to five in the morning, and the ones still out are gone at dawn; LightRanges keeps them away
from anywhere a torch or a lantern lights.
The body is read by the game's own NPC/Spawn/World codec, the shape of its own rules. The game allows
one rule per creature and environment: the thieves' other rule
(Christmas_Present_Thief_Snow_Spawns.json) names only the third zone's environments, so the two never
share one. To make the nights busier or quieter, change Weight.
